Game Overview

In Cycle Extreme, the core idea is straightforward: plunge into Cycle Extreme, the heart-racing mountain bike racer that tests your reflexes on treacherous terrain. With 20 levels of thrilling steep climbs and hazardous traps, master precision and speed to earn stars. Navigate perilous paths with tight controls and feel the adrenaline surge.
